q: Uttarakhand was carved out of Uttar Pradesh as a separate state on:
e: Uttarakhand (then Uttaranchal) was formed on 9 November 2000.

q: Jim Corbett National Park, India's first national park, was established in 1936 under the name:
e: It was set up as Hailey National Park in 1936 and later renamed after Jim Corbett.

q: The Tehri Dam, one of the tallest dams in India, is built on which river?
e: Tehri Dam stands on the Bhagirathi in Tehri Garhwal district.

q: The Bhagirathi river originates from which glacier?
e: The Bhagirathi emerges at Gaumukh, the snout of the Gangotri glacier.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the Char Dham of Uttarakhand?
e: Uttarakhand's Char Dham are Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath; Dwarka is in Gujarat.

q: The Chipko Movement of the 1970s, in which villagers hugged trees to stop felling, began in the Garhwal Himalayas of present-day:
e: The Chipko Movement began in the Garhwal region in the 1970s with leaders like Gaura Devi and Sunderlal Bahuguna.

q: Which is the highest peak lying wholly within Uttarakhand?
e: Nanda Devi (7,816 m) is the highest peak of Uttarakhand.

q: Har-ki-Pauri, a major ghat where the Kumbh Mela is held, is in:
e: Har-ki-Pauri in Haridwar is one of the four venues of the Kumbh Mela.

q: The Valley of Flowers National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is in which district?
e: The Valley of Flowers lies in Chamoli district along with Nanda Devi National Park.

q: At Devprayag, the Bhagirathi meets which river to form the Ganga?
e: The Bhagirathi and Alaknanda unite at Devprayag to form the Ganga.

q: What is the state animal of Uttarakhand?
e: The alpine musk deer (Kasturi mriga) is Uttarakhand's state animal.

q: What is the state bird of Uttarakhand?
e: The Himalayan monal is the state bird of Uttarakhand.

q: Hemkund Sahib, a high-altitude Sikh shrine beside a glacial lake, is in which district?
e: Hemkund Sahib is in Chamoli district near the Valley of Flowers.

q: Rajaji National Park in Uttarakhand is named after:
e: Rajaji National Park honours C. Rajagopalachari, popularly called Rajaji.

q: Roopkund in Uttarakhand is famous as:
o: A glacial lake with ancient human skeletons
e: Roopkund, the 'Skeleton Lake' in Chamoli, contains hundreds of ancient human remains.

q: Tungnath, one of the Panch Kedar, is famous as:
o: The seat of Adi Shankaracharya's math
The highest Shiva temple in the world
e: Tungnath in Rudraprayag district is regarded as the world's highest Shiva temple.

q: Harela, a festival of sowing and greenery, is mainly celebrated in which region of Uttarakhand?
e: Harela is a traditional Kumaoni festival celebrating the rainy season and greenery.

q: Which language is the second official language of Uttarakhand?
e: In 2010 Uttarakhand became the first state to make Sanskrit its second official language.

q: Choliya, performed with swords and shields at weddings, is a traditional dance of:
e: Choliya is a martial sword dance of the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand.

q: Which place has been declared the summer capital of Uttarakhand?
e: Gairsain (Bhararisain) in Chamoli district was declared the summer capital in 2020.
